editor.placeholder: Paste or type your JSON here...

messages.errorEmpty: Please enter some JSON to format
messages.warningFixed: JSON was auto-fixed. Check for unintended changes.

lossy.warning: Your JSON was rewritten and some values changed: {{details}}.
lossy.overflow: numbers too large for JavaScript became null
lossy.duplicateKey: duplicate keys were merged, keeping the last value

search.regexTooLong: This pattern is {{length}} characters long; the limit is {{limit}}. It was not run.
search.regexNestedQuantifier: This pattern nests one quantifier inside another, like (a+)+, a shape that can take effectively forever to match. It was not run.
search.regexTooSlow: This pattern was too slow on a short test string, so it was not run. Try a simpler one.
search.regexInvalid: This is not a valid regular expression.
search.truncatedNotice: Only the first {{shown}} of {{total}} matches are listed. Narrow the query, or add a path pattern, to reach the rest.
search.stoppedEarlyNotice: The search stopped early to keep the page responsive, so the document was not scanned to the end and the match count is a lower bound.
search.stoppedEarlyEmpty: The search stopped early to keep the page responsive, so the document was not scanned to the end.

compare.positionalArraysNotice: Arrays longer than {{limit}} items are compared by position instead of by content, so an inserted or removed item makes every item after it look modified. Compared by position: {{paths}}
compare.lineFallbackNotice: This change is too large to line up row by row, so the whole changed region is shown as one replacement: every line on the left counts as removed and every line on the right as added, including lines that are the same on both sides.

tree.editHint: Click on any value or key to edit directly
tree.typeHint: Enter keeps this value's type. Ctrl/Cmd+Enter reads the text as JSON, which is how you change the type.

errors.duplicateKey: That key already exists on this object.
errors.emptyKey: A key name cannot be empty.
errors.expectedBoolean: This value is a boolean. Enter true or false, or press Ctrl/Cmd+Enter to change its type.
errors.expectedNumber: This value is a number. Enter a number, or press Ctrl/Cmd+Enter to change its type.
errors.missingNode: That node no longer exists in the document.
errors.notRenameable: Array items are addressed by index and cannot be renamed.

map.supportedFormats: Map view supports the following formats:
map.tip: Tip: For GeoJSON, ensure geometry.type is "Point" and coordinates are [longitude, latitude]
map.tilesOffBody: Your JSON stays in the browser. Loading tiles sends map image requests to the third parties listed here, for any map style you pick, and reveals the area you are viewing and your IP address to them.
map.markerCap: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}} — the rest are not plotted.

graph.clickNode: Click a node to see details
graph.hint: click a node to expand / collapse · scroll to zoom · drag to pan

error.title: Something went wrong!
error.message: An error occurred while processing your request.

depth.title: Nested too deeply to display
depth.body: This document nests more than {{limit}} levels deep. Browsers run out of stack space on structures that deep, so this view cannot render it. Flatten or split the document to view it here.
depth.searchNotice: Branches nested more than {{limit}} levels deep were skipped, so some results may be missing.
depth.sortFailed: This document is nested too deeply to sort its keys (limit: {{limit}} levels).
depth.expandFailed: This document is nested too deeply to expand every node (limit: {{limit}} levels).

consent.title: Analytics cookies
consent.body: We use analytics cookies to count visitors and see which countries they come from. Your JSON is always processed in your browser and is never sent anywhere, whichever you choose.
